value.body: The Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), under the Department of Health Research, runs a network of research institutes across India. It recruits scientists, technical staff and administrative staff, and its institutes hire many project staff for funded studies.

items.label: Post types
items.value: Scientist; technical assistant / technician; administrative; project staff

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Eligibility depends on the post. Scientist posts generally need a master's in a relevant science, or a medical, dental or veterinary degree, with a PhD or experience for higher grades. Technical assistant posts typically need a science bachelor's; technician posts need Class 12 or a diploma. ICMR headquarters and individual institutes advertise posts; selection is by written or computer-based test and/or interview, and project posts are often filled by walk-in interview.

value.title: At a glance
items: Project posts are tied to a study's funding and end when the project ends.
Permanent recruitment happens in periodic rounds rather than every year.
Project experience helps with later PhD admissions and research jobs.
